uncheckedCast.text: '{{source}}' can't be cast to '{{target}}' here: nothing at runtime could confirm it, so the cast is trusted, not proven, and every use after it inherits the guess. Return or declare '{{target}}' where the value comes from, or build one from fields you have narrowed with typeof. A cast from a union to some of its members is allowed when a discriminant property, typeof or instanceof can tell them apart, since Adamic compiles that to a check.
